Tdoc Quota: Maximum allowed number of Tdocs for any company. This is set by the RAN3 Chairman for submission towards an Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item. It is indicated in the Chairman's Notes in the heading of each Agenda Item or Sub-Agenda Item. The quota indicated in an Agenda Item applies to the sum of the Tdocs submitted to all its sub-Agenda Items unless otherwise specified; this is to allow the freedom to prioritize which sub-topics to contribute to. Meeting the Tdoc quota does not guarantee that the Tdocs will be treated. If a sourcing company exceeds its quota for an AI, none of its contributions for that AI will be treated.
